sections.title: IRPP scale (income per part, family quotient)
sections.basis: net taxable income per part (Q = net global income / number of parts); tax = K × number of parts, K = t% × Q − N

rows.label: Family quotient: number of parts
rows.value: Single, divorced or widowed without children: 1 part; married without children or single with one child: 2 parts; each further child adds half a part, up to six children.

rows.label: Professional expenses: flat 20% deduction from salaries
rows.note: gross taxable salary after social contributions and TCS (25% for parliamentarians' and ministers' allowances).

rows.label: Professional expenses deduction: annual cap
rows.note: the 20% flat deduction for professional expenses on salaries.

rows.label: Mortgage interest on the main home: deduction cap
rows.note: interest on loans to build, buy or substantially repair a main residence in Gabon.

rows.label: Voluntary retirement contributions: deductible up to 10% of gross income
rows.note: gross taxable income (life insurance premiums and compulsory annuities up to 5%).

rows.label: Withholding on salaries: TCS and IRPP withheld monthly, paid within 15 days
rows.value: Employers withhold the TCS and the IRPP from salaries and pay the month's withholdings in the first fifteen days of the following month to the tax office of the employer's domicile.

rows.label: Rental income: flat 30% deduction for expenses
rows.note: gross rental income declared on time (or actual expenses, an option binding for three years).

rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (after a 15% abatement)
rows.note: net capital gains of the year after a 15% abatement; final.

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: IRCM: final withholding on dividends and interest
rows.note: income from shares, bonds, receivables, deposits and cash bonds (prélèvement libératoire).

source.title: IRCM (impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers)

rows.label: IRCM: interest on bank cash bonds
rows.note: interest on cash bonds (bons de caisse) issued by banks.

source.title: IRCM (impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers)

rows.label: IRCM: bonds of at least 5 years issued in Gabon
rows.note: income from bonds with a maturity of at least five years issued in Gabon.

source.title: IRCM (impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers)
IRCM (impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers)

rows.label: Taxe complémentaire sur les salaires (TCS)
rows.note: net salaries, pensions and benefits after compulsory pension and social insurance contributions; withheld by the employer; deductible for IRPP.

source.title: Règles de détermination de la TCS
Règles de détermination de la TCS

rows.label: Corporate income tax (IS): standard rate
rows.note: taxable profit of companies not subject to the 35% or 25% rates.

rows.label: IS: oil and mining companies
rows.note: taxable profit of oil and mining companies.

rows.label: IS: reduced rate (intellectual property holders, approved developers, tourism, public bodies)
rows.note: holders of intellectual property titles, the Banque Gabonaise de Développement, approved social-housing developers, public establishments, non-profit bodies and approved tourism companies.

rows.label: Minimum flat tax (IMF): 1% of turnover
rows.note: annual global turnover excluding taxes; due when higher than the IS and the minimum of collection.

rows.label: Minimum of collection (MP)
rows.note: annual IS due by every company when higher than the IS calculated and the IMF.

rows.label: TVA: liable from turnover of FCFA 60 million
rows.note: annual turnover excluding taxes; option to register below it.

rows.label: TVA standard rate
rows.note: all taxable operations not at the reduced or zero rate.

rows.label: TVA reduced rate 10% (products listed in art. 221 CGI)
rows.note: production and sale of the products listed in article 221 of the CGI.

rows.label: TVA reduced rate 5%: cement
rows.note: sales of cement.

rows.label: TVA zero rate: exports and international transport
rows.note: exports declared to customs and international transport.

rows.label: Contribution spéciale de solidarité (CSS)
rows.note: price excluding TVA and CSS of taxable sales by persons with annual turnover of FCFA 30 million or more.

rows.label: Excise duties: base on imports and on local production
rows.value: Excise duties are levied on the customs value plus duties and taxes (excluding TVA) on imports, and on the manufacturer's public selling price excluding taxes less a 30% abatement for locally made products.

rows.label: Contribution foncière unique (CFU): owner's main residence
rows.note: market or rental value less a 5% abatement (annual rental value = monthly rent × 12).

rows.label: Contribution foncière unique (CFU): other properties
rows.note: second homes, properties on company balance sheets and other cases; market or rental value less 5%.

sections.title: Property acquisition, transfer and registration taxes

rows.label: Registration duty on transfers of shares in property-holding companies
rows.note: transfers of shares in entities whose assets consist mainly of such rights or of rights in a company in Gabon.

rows.label: Registration duty on fixed-term leases
rows.note: price of fixed-term leases of movable or immovable property (3% on open-ended leases of movables).

rows.label: Fixed registration duty (acts not otherwise priced)
rows.note: acts not priced or exempted by the CGI, or where the proportional duty would be below FCFA 5,000.

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Impôt synthétique libératoire (ISL): turnover below FCFA 30 million
rows.note: annual turnover excluding taxes of individual entrepreneurs; a fixed duty by activity replaces income tax.

rows.label: Simplified regime (RSI): turnover FCFA 30 to 60 million
rows.value: Individual entrepreneurs with turnover between FCFA 30 million and 60 million are taxed under the simplified regime (RSI); above FCFA 60 million under the real regime (RRI).

rows.label: RSI flat abatement: services
rows.note: turnover of service providers under the simplified regime (70% for trade and production, 40% for liberal professions).

rows.label: RSI flat abatement: liberal professions
rows.note: turnover of liberal professions under the simplified regime.

sections.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
